G-FLAT.citation: Gutherz, E.J. 1970. Characteristics of some larval bothid flatfish, and development and distribution of larval spotfin flounder, Cyclopsetta fimbriata (Bothidae). Fishery Bulletin 68(2):261-284.
G-FLAT.key_claim: Larval bothids possess elongated anterior dorsal-fin rays with sail-like membranes bearing pigment spots.
G-FLAT.supports: 背鳍前缘延长丝状鳍条及帆状膜色素斑为鲆科仔鱼共有特征

G-FLAT.citation: Evseenko, S.A. 2008. Early life history stages of peacock flounder Bothus lunatus (Bothidae) from the western and central tropical Atlantic. Journal of Ichthyology 48(7):515-524.
G-FLAT.key_claim: Bothus larvae bear a long anterior ray in the dorsal fin; body strongly flattened and transparent at preflexion-postflexion.
G-FLAT.supports: Bothus 属仔鱼具延长背鳍条、侧扁透明体的 postflexion 期形态

G-FLAT.citation: Saldierna-Martinez, R.J., Aceves-Medina, G., Gonzalez-Navarro, E.A. 2010. Larval development of the spotfin tonguefish Symphurus oligomerus (Cynoglossidae) from the Gulf of California, Mexico. Fishery Bulletin 108(1):45-55.
G-FLAT.key_claim: Preflexion larvae have two elongated dorsal-fin rays; flexion to postflexion larvae have second to fourth rays elongate.
G-FLAT.supports: 舌鳎科仔鱼延长背鳍条数随分期变化，丝条数目可作科级判据

G-LEPTO.citation: Smith, D.G. 1979. Guide to the Leptocephali (Elopiformes, Anguilliformes, and Notacanthiformes). NOAA Technical Report NMFS Circular 424.
G-LEPTO.key_claim: Leptocephali are the characteristic larval forms of Elopiformes, Anguilliformes, and Notacanthiformes; myomere counts and anus position identify families.
G-LEPTO.supports: leptocephalus 为鳗鲡总目独有幼体型；肌节数与肛门位置用于科级鉴定

G-LEPTO.citation: Fahay, M.P. 1983. Guide to the identification of ichthyoplankton. Part IV. Anguilliformes. Journal of Northwest Atlantic Fishery Science 4:47-103.
G-LEPTO.key_claim: Anguilliform leptocephali: gelatinous leaf-like body, dense V-shaped myomeres, straight tubular gut, no pelvic fins at any stage.
G-LEPTO.supports: 胶质叶状体+密集V形肌节+直管消化道+各期均无腹鳍＝leptocephalus 定义性特征

G-LEPTO.citation: Chen, J.N., Samadi, S., Chen, W.J. 2014. Phylogeny of the Elopomorpha (Teleostei): evidence from six nuclear and mitochondrial markers. Molecular Phylogenetics and Evolution 70:152-161.
G-LEPTO.key_claim: Among morphological synapomorphies for Elopomorpha monophyly, the remarkable leptocephalus larvae stand out.
G-LEPTO.supports: leptocephalus 幼体是鳗鲡总目单系共衍征，支撑其作为分类判据的有效性

G-SERG.citation: Knight, M. & Omori, M. 1982. The larval development of Sergestes similis Hansen (Crustacea, Decapoda, Sergestidae) reared in the laboratory. Fishery Bulletin 80(2):221-242.
G-SERG.key_claim: Sergestes similis development includes nauplius I-IV, protozoea I-III (elaphocaris), zoea I-II (acanthosoma), and postlarva stages.
G-SERG.supports: 樱虾科完整发育分期序列，acanthosoma 期的定义与出现时序

G-SERG.citation: Vereshchaka, A.L. 2000. Revision of the genus Sergia (Decapoda: Dendrobranchiata: Sergestidae): taxonomy and distribution. Galathea Report 18:69-207.
G-SERG.key_claim: The acanthosoma (zoea) stage has pereopods well developed and pleopods present; carapace bears elongate lateral spines.
G-SERG.supports: acanthosoma 期头胸甲具极长侧刺、步足已发育，支撑侧刺作为幼体鉴定特征

G-SERG.citation: Williamson, D.I. 1982. Larval morphology and diversity. In: Abele, L.G. (ed.), The Biology of Crustacea, Vol. 2. Academic Press, pp. 43-110.
G-SERG.key_claim: Sergestid shrimps pass through elaphocaris (protozoea) and acanthosoma (zoea) phases with distinctive spiny carapace morphology.
G-SERG.supports: 确立 acanthosoma 术语用于樱虾科 zoea 期，多刺头胸甲为该科幼体独有

G-DEC-SHRIMP.citation: Anger, K. 2001. The Biology of Decapod Crustacean Larvae. Crustacean Issues 14. A.A. Balkema, Lisse.
G-DEC-SHRIMP.key_claim: Caridean zoea defined as planktonic shrimp-like larval stage; mysis follows zoea with biramous thoracopods; decapodid is postlarval transitional form.
G-DEC-SHRIMP.supports: 十足目幼体分期术语（zoea/mysis/decapodid）的定义与出现序列

G-DEC-SHRIMP.citation: Weiss, H.M. 2017. Keys to the Larvae of Common Decapod Crustaceans (Lobsters, Crabs and Shrimp) in Long Island Sound. NOAA Technical Report CONN-H-17-001.
G-DEC-SHRIMP.key_claim: Identification guide bridging regional manuals for decapod larvae including shrimp zoeal and mysis stages with illustrated keys and descriptions.
G-DEC-SHRIMP.supports: 十足目幼体图解检索指南，涵盖虾类 zoea 后期与 mysis 期

G-DEC-SHRIMP.citation: dos Santos, A. & Gonzalez-Gordillo, J.I. 2004. Illustrated keys for the identification of the Pleocyemata (Crustacea: Decapoda) zoeal stages from south-western Europe. J. Mar. Biol. Assoc. UK 84(1):205-227.
G-DEC-SHRIMP.key_claim: Keys cover 127 Pleocyemata taxa including Caridea zoeal stages based on external morphological characters observable under stereomicroscope.
G-DEC-SHRIMP.supports: 真虾下目 zoea 外部形态检索，覆盖 127 个类群的科级至种级特征

G-DEC-CRAB.citation: Clark, P.F., Calazans, D.K. & Pohle, G.W. 1998. Accuracy and standardization of brachyuran larval descriptions. Invertebrate Reproduction & Development 33(2-3):127-144.
G-DEC-CRAB.key_claim: Standardized terminology and descriptive model for brachyuran zoea and megalopa morphology; rostral, dorsal and lateral spine characters defined for familial diagnosis.
G-DEC-CRAB.supports: 蟹类 zoea/megalopa 标准化描述体系；额刺背刺侧刺用于科级诊断

G-DEC-CRAB.citation: Kornienko, E.S. & Korn, O.M. 2009. Illustrated key for the identification of brachyuran zoeal stages in the plankton of Peter the Great Bay (Sea of Japan). J. Mar. Biol. Assoc. UK 89(2):379-386.
G-DEC-CRAB.key_claim: Dichotomous key for 16 brachyuran zoeal taxa using conspicuous external characters including carapace spines visible under stereomicroscope without dissection.
G-DEC-CRAB.supports: 蟹类 zoea 检索表：头胸甲刺式作为无需解剖即可观察的科级鉴别特征

G-DEC-CRAB.citation: Ingle, R.W. 1992. Larval Stages of Northeastern Atlantic Crabs: An Illustrated Key. Chapman & Hall, London.
G-DEC-CRAB.key_claim: Comprehensive illustrated key covering zoeal and megalopal stages of NE Atlantic Brachyura with diagnostic carapace spine ratios and appendage setation patterns.
G-DEC-CRAB.supports: 区域蟹类幼体图解专著，zoea 与 megalopa 的定义性形态描述

G-PHYL.citation: Kittaka, J. 1994. Culture of phyllosomas of spiny lobster and its application to studies of larval recruitment and aquaculture. Crustaceana 66(3):258-270.
G-PHYL.key_claim: Phyllosoma instar counts established: 17 instars for Jasus spp., 9 estimated for Palinurus elephas, 25 estimated for Panulirus japonicus.
G-PHYL.supports: phyllosoma 分期（instar）体系的实验依据与蜕皮次数量化

G-PHYL.citation: McWilliam, P.S. & Phillips, B.F. 1987. Distinguishing the phyllosoma larvae of rock lobster species of the genus Jasus. Crustaceana 52(1):1-24.
G-PHYL.key_claim: Morphological characters distinguishing mid- and final-stage phyllosoma of Jasus species; fifth biramous pereopod unique to J. verreauxi phyllosoma.
G-PHYL.supports: phyllosoma 中后期形态鉴别特征与属种级差异的描述方法

G-PHYL.citation: Phillips, B.F., McWilliam, P.S. & Rimmer, D.W. 1986. The pelagic phase of spiny lobster development. Can. J. Fish. Aquat. Sci. 43(12):2534-2543.
G-PHYL.key_claim: Phyllosoma defined as transparent dorso-ventrally flattened larval form adapted to suspended pelagic existence; puerulus completes pelagic phase.
G-PHYL.supports: phyllosoma 幼体型定义：极度侧扁透明叶状体、浮游适应；至 puerulus 的变态

G-STOM.citation: Morgan, S.G. & Goy, J.W. 1987. Reproduction and larval development of the mantis shrimp Gonodactylus bredini maintained in the laboratory. Journal of Crustacean Biology 7(4):595-618.
G-STOM.key_claim: Larvae progress through seven pelagic stages; raptorial appendages differentiate progressively, with the second thoracopod becoming markedly enlarged by late stages.
G-STOM.supports: 掠肢（第二胸肢）在幼体后期显著特化增大；七期幼体序列定义 pseudozoea 至 alima 转变

G-STOM.citation: Haug, J.T., Haug, C., Maas, A., Kutschera, V. & Waloszek, D. 2010. Evolution of mantis shrimps (Stomatopoda, Malacostraca) in the light of new Mesozoic fossils. BMC Evolutionary Biology 10:290.
G-STOM.key_claim: Four pairs of raptorial thoracopods present in larvae; size differentiation pattern (one large, three small) is a derived character appearing post-larvally.
G-STOM.supports: 幼体期已有四对掠肢但大小分化随发育变化；尾扇与腹肢存在可辨发育序列

G-STOM.citation: Fadl, A.E.A., Wakabayashi, K. & Fujita, K. 2021. Morphological observations and molecular confirmation of larvae of Levisquilla inermis (Crustacea: Stomatopoda) from the Seto Inland Sea. J. Mar. Biol. Assoc. UK 101(5):749-759.
G-STOM.key_claim: Last-stage larva possesses fully developed raptorial appendages, stalked compound eyes, plumose pleopods, and tail fan.
G-STOM.supports: 末期幼体具完整掠肢、有柄复眼、羽状腹肢与尾扇——与本图像素组合一致

G-BIVALVE.citation: Loosanoff, V.L. & Davis, H.C. 1963. Rearing of bivalve mollusks. Advances in Marine Biology 1:1-136.
G-BIVALVE.key_claim: Bivalve larvae pass through trochophore, straight-hinge (D-shaped) veliger, umboned veliger, and pediveliger stages; prodissoconch I forms at D-stage.
G-BIVALVE.supports: 双壳类幼体分期序列（担轮到D形面盘到壳顶面盘到具足面盘）与原壳形成时序

G-BIVALVE.citation: Lutz, R.A., Mann, R., Haskin, H.H. et al. 2018. Scanning electron microscopic aids for identification of larval and post-larval bivalves. Journal of Shellfish Research 37(2):247-448.
G-BIVALVE.key_claim: Disarticulated shell valve SEM reveals prodissoconch morphology, hinge dentition, and shell microsculpture as diagnostic characters for species-level larval identification.
G-BIVALVE.supports: 原壳形态、铰合齿与壳面微雕饰是双壳幼体鉴定依据——本图 1200px 下无法读取，故停层

G-BIVALVE.citation: Semenikhina, O.Y., Yurchenko, O.V. & Maslennikov, S.I. 2008. Morphology of larvae of the family Mytilidae (Bivalvia) from the northwestern Sea of Japan. J. Mar. Biol. Assoc. UK 88(3):551-558.
G-BIVALVE.key_claim: Mytilid larvae distinguished by D-shaped shell, absence of umbo in early veliger; velum and foot bud visible within transparent valves.
G-BIVALVE.supports: 透明壳瓣内可见面盘与足芽；D形壳与早期无壳顶为面盘幼虫判据

G-PHOR.citation: Temereva, E.N. & Malakhov, V.V. 2015. Metamorphic remodeling of morphology and the body cavity in Phoronopsis harmeri (Lophotrochozoa, Phoronida). BMC Evolutionary Biology 15:229.
G-PHOR.key_claim: Juvenile body forms from the metasomal sac of the larva; larval hood is engulfed during catastrophic metamorphosis; telotroch undergoes cell death.
G-PHOR.supports: 成体由幼体后体囊外翻形成；口前罩在灾变性变态中被吞噬；telotroch 退化

G-PHOR.citation: Strathmann, R.R. & Bone, Q. 1997. Ciliary feeding assisted by suction from the muscular oral hood of phoronid larvae. Biological Bulletin 193(2):153-162.
G-PHOR.key_claim: Phoronid larvae have an oral hood upstream from a postoral encircling array of ciliated tentacles.
G-PHOR.supports: 口前罩位于口后环列设毛触手之上游——本图判门的门级特征组合

G-PHOR.citation: Santagata, S. 2004. Larval development of Phoronis pallida (Phoronida): implications for morphological convergence and divergence among larval body plans. Journal of Morphology 261(1):59-78.
G-PHOR.key_claim: Actinotroch larva reared to competence; preoral lobe (hood), postoral tentacle ring, and telotroch documented via SEM and confocal.
G-PHOR.supports: 辐轮幼虫三件套（口前叶/口后触手环/telotroch）的实验室发育时序与形态确认

G-MEDUSA.citation: Kramp, P.L. 1961. Order Rhizostomeae. Journal of the Marine Biological Association of the United Kingdom 40(1):348-382.
G-MEDUSA.key_claim: Scyphomedusae with umbrella margin cleft into lappets; without marginal tentacles; without a central mouth; fleshy branched oral arms.
G-MEDUSA.supports: 根口水母目定义特征：伞缘裂片、无缘触手、无中央口、肉质分枝口腕

G-MEDUSA.citation: Holst, S., Sotje, I., Tieman, H. & Jarms, G. 2007. Life cycle of the rhizostome jellyfish Rhizostoma octopus (Scyphozoa, Rhizostomae). Marine Biology 151:1695-1710.
G-MEDUSA.key_claim: Rhizostomeae medusae develop through polyp strobilation releasing ephyrae that undergo dramatic metamorphosis into adult medusa form.
G-MEDUSA.supports: 钵水母生活史 polyp 到 strobila 到 ephyra 到 medusa 含剧烈变态，支撑本图 stage=adult 仍纳入的依据

G-MEDUSA.citation: Holst, S. 2012. Morphology and development of benthic and pelagic life stages of North Sea jellyfish (Scyphozoa), with emphasis on ephyra stages. Marine Biology 159:2707-2722.
G-MEDUSA.key_claim: Identification key for scyphozoan ephyrae including Rhizostoma octopus; ephyrae distinguished by lappet number, rhopalia, and canal pattern.
G-MEDUSA.supports: 碟状体（ephyra）鉴定特征：缘瓣数、触手囊与水管构型

G-POLYL.citation: Abe, H. & Sato-Okoshi, W. 2021. Molecular identification and larval morphology of spionid polychaetes (Annelida, Spionidae) from northeastern Japan. ZooKeys 1015:1-86.
G-POLYL.key_claim: Trochophore, metatrochophore, and nectochaete defined as larvae with prototroch, segmentation signs, and functional parapodia respectively; chaetae used for family-level identification.
G-POLYL.supports: 多毛类幼体期序列术语定义与刚毛类型在科级鉴定中的作用

G-POLYL.citation: Blake, J.A. 2017. Larval development of Polychaeta from the northern California coast: fourteen additional species with seasonality of planktic larvae over 5 years. J. Mar. Biol. Assoc. UK 97(5):1053-1084.
G-POLYL.key_claim: Detailed descriptions of planktonic polychaete larval stages across eight families; prostomium shape, parapodial morphology, and chaetal types diagnostic at family level.
G-POLYL.supports: 头叶形状、疣足形态与刚毛类型是多毛幼体科级判据

G-POLYL.citation: Fauchald, K. 1977. The polychaete worms: Definitions and keys to the orders, families and genera. Science Series 28. Natural History Museum of Los Angeles County.
G-POLYL.key_claim: Comprehensive definitions and keys to polychaete orders, families and genera based on parapodia, chaetae, prostomium, and body segmentation.
G-POLYL.supports: 多毛类分类专著：基于疣足、刚毛、头叶与分节的科级以上检索体系

G-FISHMISC.citation: Richards, W.J. (ed.) 2005. Early Stages of Atlantic Fishes: An Identification Guide for the Western Central North Atlantic. Two-volume set. Taylor & Francis, 2640 pp.
G-FISHMISC.key_claim: Comprehensive identification guide covering egg, yolk-sac, larval, transformation, and juvenile stages with meristic and morphometric keys.
G-FISHMISC.supports: 鱼类仔稚鱼鉴定通用一级专著：覆盖卵黄囊期至稚鱼期的计数与量度检索

G-FISHMISC.citation: Shono, T., Thiery, A.P., Cooper, R.L., Kurokawa, D., Britz, R., Okabe, M. & Fraser, G.J. 2019. Evolution and developmental diversity of skin spines in pufferfishes. iScience 19:1248-1259.
G-FISHMISC.key_claim: Pufferfish (Tetraodontidae) possess individual dermal spines varying from complete body coverage to ventral restriction; spines develop from mesenchymal condensations in early ontogeny.
G-FISHMISC.supports: 鲀形目体表刺的发育起源与分布多样性，支撑球形密刺仔鱼的鲀形目归属

G-FISHMISC.citation: Silva-Segundo, C.A. et al. 2024. Molecular and morphological identification of larvae of carangid fishes (Teleostei: Carangidae) from the southwestern Gulf of Mexico. ZooKeys 1215:1-30.
G-FISHMISC.key_claim: Diagnostic morphological characters described for nine carangid larval species; elongated dorsal and anal fin filaments characteristic of larval Caranx and Decapterus.
G-FISHMISC.supports: 鲹科仔鱼延长背臀鳍丝条的诊断形态，支撑菱形体加大量延长丝条标本的鲹形目候选
